Event Coordination: Logistics, stakeholder liaison, and communication for large-scale events
Administrative Support: Document management, data analysis, report writing

paragraphs: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Assistente Administrativo - Home-Office position at Empresa Confidencial. With a proven track record of coordinating large-scale events and managing complex administrative tasks, I believe my skills align perfectly with your requirements.

During my internship at International House Oulu, I successfully coordinated 14 community events, averaging 25 international participants each. My experience in logistics, communications, and stakeholder liaison makes me confident that I can excel in the event coordination aspects of this role.

In addition to my event management skills, I have significant legal experience. As a Legal Associate at Poise Legal, India, I drafted, reviewed, and negotiated 5-7 commercial agreements per month for four corporate clients. This experience has equipped me with strong contract management and research capabilities that will be valuable in supporting your administrative needs.

I am currently completing Finnish supplementary law studies at the University of Lapland (OPH-recognised), which reflects my commitment to integrating my international legal expertise with the local system. I am fluent in both English and Finnish, and I am confident that these language skills will enable me to communicate effectively within your team.

I am excited about the opportunity to bring my diverse skill set to Empresa Confidencial's Home-Office team. Thank you for considering my application, and I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to your organization.
